headline: Inside is the play: Sat backside yellows, Sun flat-water halibut
body:
The small craft advisory on the books runs only through late Tuesday night, but the NWS trend into Friday keeps the outer waters at 15–25 kt with 6–8 ft seas, and the weekend point data outside is no kinder: Santa Rosa Flats 6.2 ft Saturday and 7.5 ft Sunday, Osborn 6 then 7.1 with 17 kn NNE by late Sunday, San Nicolas 6.2 then 7.7 with gusts to 19. Skip the long runs both days — the 66.9° break on the Flats Saturday is the only real bluefin temperature showing, and it isn't worth 40 nm of six-foot chop. The bank rockfish grounds out west sit under that same slop.

Saturday belongs to the backside of Santa Cruz: 72°, 4.1 ft, and essentially no wind midday. Work the 80-ft troll lines early. Sunday the backside warms to 73.9° but wind swings ENE 8 kn with 4.5 ft. Better Sunday call is halibut on the Goleta–Carpinteria sand — 3 ft, 1–5 kn, 69.9° — a genuinely easy day on the flats.
